summary: Datasheet-verified cross-reference alternatives for AMS1117-3.3 (Advanced Monolithic Systems, SOT-223-3, fixed-ldo): evaluated 29 same-category OPNs, surfacing 1 Level 1 Candidate Drop-In, 3 Level 2 Tuning Required, and 4 Level 3 Layout Change options. Verify pinout, thermal margin, and official manufacturer datasheets before production.

candidates.key_advantage: Matching SOT-223-3 pinout & ratings for second-sourcing
Lower Iq (65 µA vs 5000 µA); Lower dropout (800 mV vs 1100 mV)
Ceramic MLCC stable (no tantalum ESR floor)

candidates.key_tradeoff: Verify θJA (160 °C/W) and latest onsemi datasheet revision

candidates.compatibility_badge: PCB Layout Change Required (Pinout or Package Mismatch)
candidates.key_advantage: Lower Iq (60 µA vs 5000 µA); Lower dropout (340 mV vs 1100 mV)
candidates.key_tradeoff: Pinout or exposed-pad mismatch requires PCB rerouting; Lower Vin,max (6 V vs 15 V)

candidates.compatibility_badge: PCB Layout Change Required (Pinout or Package Mismatch)
candidates.key_advantage: Lower Iq (2000 µA vs 5000 µA); Higher Vin,max (26 V vs 15 V)
candidates.key_tradeoff: Pinout or exposed-pad mismatch requires PCB rerouting; Lower Iout (400 mA vs 1000 mA)

candidates.compatibility_badge: PCB Layout Change Required (Pinout or Package Mismatch)
candidates.key_advantage: Lower Iq (20 µA vs 5000 µA); Higher Vin,max (24 V vs 15 V)
candidates.key_tradeoff: Package change (SOT-223-3 → SOT-23-5) requires PCB layout mod; Lower Iout (150 mA vs 1000 mA)

candidates.compatibility_badge: PCB Layout Change Required (Pinout or Package Mismatch)
candidates.key_advantage: Lower Iq (69 µA vs 5000 µA); Lower dropout (180 mV vs 1100 mV)
candidates.key_tradeoff: Package change (SOT-223-3 → SOT-23-5) requires PCB layout mod; Lower Iout (150 mA vs 1000 mA)

selection_checklist: Verify exact pin numbering on SOT-223-3 (1=GND, 2=VOUT, 3=VIN) and exposed pad net (VOUT).
Confirm output capacitor ESR stability (ESR window See datasheet ESR curve) and DC-bias derated capacitance >= 22 µF.
Check worst-case junction temperature Tj = Ta + (Vin,max - 3.3 V) × Iout × θJA stays >= 15 °C below Tj,max (125 °C).
Validate input transient headroom against Vin,max (15 V rec / 15 V abs) and Pin 4 (NC vs BYPASS) PCB net connectivity.
